headline: Revenue growth accelerates, profit swings sharply higher
summary_short: Microchip reported revenue of $1.48B for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, up 38.0% y/y and 13.2% q/q, with GAAP diluted EPS of $0.37 versus a $0.09 per-share loss a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue rose 13.2% q/q and 38.0% y/y to $1.485B, above the high end of prior guidance, on improving demand, inventory normalization, and stronger factory utilization. GAAP operating income jumped to $336.8M (22.7% of sales) from $32.1M a year ago as higher factory utilization and disciplined expense management drove operating leverage; GAAP diluted EPS was $0.37, versus a $0.09 loss a year ago. Free cash flow was $497.6M. The company reduced net debt by ~$170M and returned $246.9M to shareholders via dividends. For the September quarter, Microchip guided net sales up 7-9% sequentially and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.53-0.54.
confidence_notes: This run was executed in the requested 'force-regenerate' mode, but no prior MCHP_US_FY2026_Q2 summary was found on disk or in git history — this is a first compose, not an overwrite. Fiscal-offset note: Microchip's own release labels this quarter ‘first quarter of fiscal year 2027’ (three months ended June 30, 2026); our shard uses the calendar-quarter label FY2026 Q2 for the same underlying quarter — same numbers, different labeling convention. GAAP net income of $229.8M (resolver's net_income_usd_m) is pre-preferred-dividend; diluted EPS of $0.37 is computed on net income attributable to common stockholders of $202.0M after $27.8M of Series A preferred dividends. Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $0.76 vs GAAP $0.37, mainly reflecting share-based compensation, acquisition-related intangible amortization, restructuring charges, and the preferred dividend add-back.

drivers.explanation: Improving demand, continued inventory normalization, and stronger factory utilization drove the sequential and y/y increase; distribution sell-through rose and book-to-bill stayed well above 1.
Higher factory utilization, lower underutilization charges, and disciplined expense management drove sequential operating leverage and margin expansion.
GAAP EPS of $0.37 remained well below non-GAAP EPS of $0.76 because GAAP results were adversely impacted by amortization of acquired intangible assets and other non-GAAP-excluded items.

Management cited a broad demand recovery, inventory normalization, and PCIe Gen6 design wins doubling sequentially (6 to 12 programs); guided September-quarter net sales up 7-9% q/q and continued net debt reduction (~$170M this quarter).
